text:
elaine: Heads up - POC with OrbitPay in 25m. Customer copied key from UI but every /v1/embeddings call returns 403: {"error":{"message":"permission denied: tenant mismatch","code":403}}. They say the dashboard shows key attached to "orbitpay-main" :weary:

samir: that "tenant mismatch" string usually means the key is bound to a different org/tenant than the request header (Redwood-Org) or their SDK is sending a different env. Quick asks: can you get a sanitized header dump and key id/account id?

presales-bot: Tip: Keys created via the sales console can be bound to a staging tenant by default. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#key-bindings :information_source:

elaine: customer paste (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_orbit_42" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-text-embed","input":"hello"}'
```
No Redwood-Org or X-Project headers. Dashboard says key bound to org `orbitpay-main`. They also have an internal wrapper that sets REDWOOD_ORG=orbitpay-prod (note the different suffix).

meera: env mismatch is very common. If their SDK picks up REDWOOD_ORG=orbitpay-prod and the key is bound to orbitpay-main you'll hit that 403. Easiest fix: ask them to set explicit header `Redwood-Org: orbitpay-main` in the demo.

elaine: security won't rotate keys. They asked if we can make the key accept orbitpay-prod requests for the demo (no code change).

ops: we can add a temporary tenant alias mapping server-side for that account. Requires approval and audit. How long do they need it?

samir: also ask them to try this debug curl to confirm it's header related: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_orbit_42" 
 -H "Redwood-Org: orbitpay-main" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-text-embed","input":"status"}'
```
If 200 -> header fix. If still 403 we need x-rw-request-id.

elaine: they tried header curl and got 403 still. Response included `x-rw-request-id: rq_abc123` and body: `{"error":{"message":"permission denied: action not permitted: embeddings.create","code":403}}`.

meera: that suggests the key policy doesn't allow embeddings.create. Keys can be scoped to actions (e.g., embeddings-only, generate-only). We'll need to inspect policy server-side. Please send key id (not secret) + account id.

elaine: account `acct_77122`, key id `key_orbit_42`. Customer insists no policy changes without legal sign-off. Can we do a temporary action grant for demo?

ops: temporary action grants are possible but must be approved by SecOps and logged. We can grant embeddings.create for up to 30 minutes. Also can bump RPS to 20 for the demo window if they saw rate limits earlier.

presales-bot: Checklist: [x] collect key id/account, [x] try explicit Redwood-Org header, [x] collect x-rw-request-id, [ ] request temporary action grant, [ ] log audit entry, [ ] optional RPS bump. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/troubleshooting#auth-403

meera: one more debug step: ask customer to call a different endpoint allowed by limited keys (e.g., /v1/usage or /v1/ping) that often returns 200 even for restricted keys. If that succeeds, it's definitely action-based.

elaine: they ran `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_orbit_42"` and got 200. So it's action-limited.

ops: I'll draft the SecOps exception: "Temporary grant embeddings.create for key key_orbit_42 on acct_77122 for 30m for live sales demo; approver ops; audit required." Approving RPS bump to 20. @audit-bot please record.

audit-bot: Audit entry created: "TEMP-PERM-GRANT acct_77122 key_orbit_42 embeddings.create expire_in=30m approver=ops reason='live sales demo'"

meera: once we flip the permission please have them retry and paste the x-rw-request-id if it still fails. Also suggest they correct their REDWOOD_ORG env to avoid future issues.

elaine: thanks team. I'll update the customer: temporary grant + RPS bump live in 5m, please retry then and paste `x-rw-request-id` if any failure. Will report back. :thumbsup:
